answer: The pigment lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the meadow is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, re-queued for a second panel, rewards vest against future work. By the sparrow of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
